title: Serve Armour
intro: An upper-body session for an arm that plays a racket sport. Pull-led, because pulling is the half your sport never trains.
Two sets of bench on purpose, and a light set of wrist work at the end. Your shoulder presses all week already, and the elbow is usually where the forearm ends up complaining.

before.label: Not today
before.text: A sore shoulder, elbow, wrist or neck, or an injury in the last month? Get it looked at first.

before.label: Stop and get it checked
before.text: A sharp pain, pain that spreads, numbness or pins and needles down the arm, swelling, a shoulder that slips or comes out, or a sudden pop.

before.label: Stop now
before.text: Chest pain, dizziness, a heartbeat that races or skips, or breathing that doesn't feel right. Get it looked at before you train again. Told to be careful with hard exercise? Check with your doctor first.

before.label: While you train
before.text: If pressing overhead pinches the front or top of your shoulder, stop that press there and skip it today.

before.label: A day or two later
before.text: Far more sore than normal, or your pee goes dark? Get it checked the same day.

before.label: First time
before.text: Do two sets of each lift instead of the full sets, and see how you feel in two days.

good: Easy pace, any machine if there is no rower
Warm and breathing, nothing more
Start small and grow the circle as it loosens
Backward circles matter more for your sport
bad: Starting with the biggest circle you can make

good: Knees stacked, open the top arm and follow it with your eyes
Feel the turn in the ribs
Face down, lift the arms a few inches, thumbs up
Feel the muscles between the shoulder blades switch on
One light set of the first working movement
Groove the path and feel the shoulder
bad: Going straight to your working weight

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row

good: Flat back, pull to the hip and pause at the top
Feel it in the mid-back, not the arm
bad: Twisting the torso to get the dumbbell higher

exercises.note: Pulling leads this session on purpose.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Overhead Press

good: Press straight up beside the ear, not out in front
Squeeze the back glute and keep the ribs down
bad: Leaning back to press the weight up

exercises.note: Kneeling is what stops your lower back arching to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press

good: Elbows about 45 degrees from the body
Chest does the work, not the front of the shoulder
bad: Letting the elbows flare out wide

exercises.note: Two sets only, and that is on purpose.

good: Hinge over, light weight, lead with the elbows
Feel the back of the shoulder
bad: Going so heavy it becomes a row

exercises.name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension

good: Forearm on your thigh, palm down, very light and slow
Feel the top of the forearm

exercises.note: This is the one that keeps tennis elbow away.

good: Pick it up like a deadlift, then walk tall
Do not let yourself lean away from it
bad: Bending over and yanking it off the floor
